versions.changelog: Add contact line for custom implementations (pods@agentmail.to)

SkillSpector v2.4.26 security review: all 13 findings resolved. Silent AGENTS.md patching removed from --detect and interactive modes. patch_agents_md() now requires explicit user confirmation. YAML permissions block added. Trigger description tightened (removed broad UTC/heartbeat triggers). Eastern timezone bias fixed in examples. tz_config.json excluded from package via .skillignore. tz_config.example.json added with neutral placeholders. USER.md access justified in docstring.

agent-timezone-lock v1.1.0

- Simplified and clarified SKILL.md documentation for easier setup and understanding
- Setup script (`timezone_setup.py`) now requires explicit `--patch-agents` flag before editing AGENTS.md
- Accepts common timezone aliases (ET, PT, CT) in addition to IANA names
- Permissions, setup steps, and intended triggers now clearly documented
- Removed skill-card.md and added SKILL.md.bak as a backup

- Initial release of agent-timezone-lock skill.
- Ensures the agent always reports time in the configured local timezone, never UTC-as-local.
- Validates and enforces a proper IANA timezone string via USER.md and prompts for correction if invalid.
- Adds /timezone command for checking and changing timezone interactively.
- Prevents reporting UTC times as local, with detection and correction mechanisms in heartbeats.
- Requires explicit use of now.py for every time output; does not auto-intercept all time reporting.
